title: Stable Identity, Versioning & Synchronization
objective: A future owner Continue must governed-start a bounded stable-identity, versioning and synchronization tranche before any VTI-03 acceptance package or production implementation begins.
selection_boundaries: VTI-02 remains completed_verified and frozen with its implementation authority retired.
Multiversal remains canonical rules/campaign authority; external VTT state is derivative and may not supersede canonical Multiversal state.

VTI-03 selection authorizes no implementation branch, acceptance package, credentials, external account mutation, adapter implementation, synchronization mutation, persistence, package distribution or canonical game-state mutation.

The future governed start may bound external-object mappings, stable fingerprints/identity, version negotiation, stale/conflict handling, reconnect, deduplication, tombstones and MIB-03 retry/recovery semantics without widening into VTI-04 rules-action/roll bridging.

Provider-specific schemas and vendor selection remain deferred; platform selection remains evidence-driven at VTI-09.
VTI-04+, SGC-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
